sources.snippet: Overview LTX2.3_comfy is a quantized checkpoint version of the LTX 2.3 diffusion model optimized for ComfyUI, developed by Kijai. This model uses fp8 quantization with experimental input scaling to reduce memory requirements while maintaining generation quality.
